acceptance: Each listed query has an adapter and its implementation reads every value the SQL varies
The inventory test's lists lose these queries and the test passes
With the adapter binding, each query matches the DuckDB reference on both families at SF 0.1, or the reason is documented (for example vacuous empty at that scale)
No other query's status changes in the SF 0.1 per-query probe
description: For each listed query: add an adapter in benchbox/core/tpcds/dataframe_queries/parameter_adapters.py from dsqgen -LOG names to the DataFrame keys (reproduce template arithmetic such as [MONTH]+1); make the implementation read the mapped keys with no literal fallback (Q8 and Q10 currently have literal fallbacks); delete dead YAML keys in default_parameters.yaml; remove the query from BINDING_GAP (and LITERAL_FALLBACK) in tests/unit/core/tpcds/test_parameter_consumption_inventory.py so the strict xfail turns into a pass. Follow the t04 pattern (bind_parameters, ParameterBinding, parameter_overrides). Queries.py edits queue one PR at a time, never two queries.py PRs in the merge queue together. Effort about 2 days (judgement, not measured).
